ceremony.scoped_git_commit._rationale: C8 (2026-08-11-claim-release-and-the-gate-that-cannot-clear.md), A8/A10: Re-baselined DOWNWARD 2026-08-19 (commit-gate spawn dedup): green_path 17->16, directory_pathspec_expansion 18->17, push_raced_path 20->19, pending_drain_superseded 23->22, and every op_total_ key by 2. The delta is `commit_gates.deletion_block_gate` no longer issuing Assertion-2's two reads (`git diff --cached --name-only` and the whole-HEAD `git ls-tree -r HEAD --name-only` walk) when the composed message carries no Kept (Step 2.67) claim -- nothing else in that function consumes either set, so on a Kept-less message they were computed and discarded. Only ONE of the two is visible to the seam counter: `commit_gates` binds `_git` by direct import at module load, so its `ls-tree` call has never routed through the `git_native._git` name the counter wraps, which is why the seam keys move by 1 and the op_total keys by 2. This is a REDUCTION, not a bound fitted to an unreduced set -- the skipped reads are skipped only when their sole consumer would iterate an empty claim list, and a Kept-bearing message still pays both. Measured on the live tree the same day: the gate's own cost falls from 3 spawns to 1 on the Kept-less path. Superseded figures and their provenance follow.  end-to-end git-SUBPROCESS-SPAWN COUNT (not latency -- a timing figure is noise on this repo's 50-70-concurrent-session box, see CLAUDE.md load norm) for the whole `_handler`/`run_commit_pipeline` staging+commit+push pipeline, measured via `git_native._git` -- this op's sole native-git choke point (git_native.py's own docstring). Enforced by `test_commit_e2e_spawn_budget.py`. `target_ms`/`tolerance` are carried only to satisfy `budget.py._validated_budget`'s required override shape; this op is NOT in `op_fixtures.COMPUTE_ONLY_FIXTURES` (it is MUTATING, not swept automatically), so the ms figure is inert/advisory -- `spawn_count_budget` is the actually-enforced invariant. Re-baselined 2026-08-18: green_path 12->17, directory_pathspec_expansion 13->18. The +5 is identical on both keys and contains no probe call: `git_native`'s agree-branch CAS reads its index/HEAD blob pair twice by construction (`_index_blobs`/`_head_blobs` at capture, then `_agree_branch_cas_refusal`'s re-read immediately before the agree branch's own `git add`, which is what makes it a compare-and-swap rather than a single observation), and `interpret-trailers --no-divider --in-place` stamps the message. Four CAS reads plus one trailer stamp. All of it landed after the 2026-08-11 figure below without moving this budget, and this module carries `pytest.mark.cadence` so the fast tier never ran the assertion that would have caught it. Re-baselined rather than reduced because every one of the five is doing named, correctness-bearing work -- this is not a bound fitted to an unreduced spawn set, which stays forbidden. Superseded figures, retained as the provenance of the delta: measured 2026-08-11 on this repo: green_path=12 (rename-diff status probe x2, ls-files --deleted, check-ignore stdin probe, add x2, diff --cached --name-only, --no-optional-locks status, rev-parse HEAD, commit, post-commit Commit-Token log search, remote); refusal_path_unanswerable=0 (an UNANSWERABLE path -- e.g. unverified caller identity conflicting with a live claimant -- short-circuits `_handler` before any staging spawn); directory_pathspec_expansion=13 (green_path's 12 plus the one extra pathspec-scoped `git status --porcelain -- <dir>` `_expand_directory_pathspecs` issues before the rest of the pipeline runs). push_raced_path=20, added by opro-01 C-09 as probe_bearing_path=24 and lowered to its post-C-02 figure under COORDINATOR-RESOLUTIONS.md Resolution 2 (measured 2026-08-18): the push-raced/push-failed path -- the only path `_remote_sha_state`'s remote-confirmation probe is reachable on, and the one the probe's cost actually lands on. `green_path` was deliberately NOT raised to absorb any of this: that figure's fixture configures no remote and no upstream, so the probe was unreachable there and budgeting for spawns the green path cannot make would have been C-12's forbidden move. Its separate 12->17 re-baseline above is unrelated drift, not this. The 24 comprises the staging/commit leg plus a push-remote census, a failing `push`, and the probe's own 4 (`rev-parse --abbrev-ref @{u}` once, `merge-base --is-ancestor` x3 across the retry loop), the latter four invisible to this counter until C-09 routed them through `git_native._git`. C-01/C-02 then removed the probe outright (one publisher per commit makes this op's own push status authoritative, so there is nothing left to corroborate against the remote): 24 -> 20 spawns and 1.0s -> 0s of hot-path `time.sleep`, measured 2026-08-18 on the same fixture. The key is renamed accordingly -- the path is still the push-raced one, it simply no longer bears a probe. `test_commit_e2e_spawn_budget.py` asserts both the count and that the path sleeps zero, since a spawn count cannot express a sleep and the sleep was half of what this shed. A8's pre-amendment '+1' referred to the CONJUNCTION-path delta inside `_check_claim_conflicts` alone (C5's own lazy call, see test_commit_gate_budget.py), not this op-level figure -- see that test module and this chunk's run-report sidecar for the reconciliation. `pending_drain_superseded`=23, opro-03 C6, measured 2026-08-19: a SEPARATE `git_native._git` shape from the other three -- this fixture's own commit lands on a clean `work/main` (the ordinary green-path staging/commit/push leg, unrelated to the number below), while a SECOND, synthetic branch `work/pending` is engineered non-fast-forward-superseded against origin and named by a planted `coordinator-auto-push-pending.json` record so `_drain_pending_push_after_sync` -> `auto_push.drain_pending_push` -> `run_push_with_retry(..., _skip_hold=True)` fires after the op's own push succeeds. None of `auto_push`'s own git calls (`push_once`, `_is_ancestor`, the fetch inside `_is_superseded`) route through `git_native._git` -- see the sibling `op_total_pending_drain_superseded` key for why they are counted at all -- so this seam figure is simply this fixture's own green-path-shaped commit cost on `work/main` (staging/commit/push, same shape as `green_path`'s own 17, plus this fixture's own six extra native-git calls the drain's bookkeeping and the extra branch add on top).
ceremony.scoped_git_commit._op_total_rationale: opro-03 C6, measured 2026-08-19 on this repo. TWO LAYERS OF KEY, deliberately, and they must not be collapsed. The bare shape keys (green_path/directory_pathspec_expansion/push_raced_path/pending_drain_superseded) count the `git_native._git` NATIVE-GIT seam, via a function-OBJECT substitution in test_commit_e2e_spawn_budget.py -- mechanism-robust but ROUTING-NARROW: a spawn that reaches the process boundary without going through `_git()` is invisible to them by construction. The op does exactly that in three measured places reachable from `_handler` (`session/scope.py::_git_run` via claim release, `hooks/auto_push.py::_run_git` via `run_commit_pipeline` -> `_drain_pending_push_after_sync`, and `git/divergence.py::_run_git`), so those legs could grow without bound and the seam figures would never move. The op_total_* keys close that: counted by substituting the `subprocess.run` MODULE ATTRIBUTE, scoped to the op invocation only (a test-scoped counter would be mostly fixture -- 28/29/37 per test versus these op-only figures). Deltas over the seam figures are +6/+6/+8 and that GAP IS THE POINT: it is the uncounted-bypass surface enumerated by coordinator_core/tests/test_no_uncounted_spawn_on_budgeted_path.py. Shrinking it by routing a bypass through the counted seam is progress; shrinking it by editing these numbers is the failure this plan's anti-scope names. No spawn was added by any of this -- each key makes existing spawns countable. op_total for refusal_path_unanswerable is deliberately absent: that path short-circuits before any spawn, so its seam figure of 0 is already a whole-op 0. The counter's own hole is mechanism, not routing (it sees `subprocess.run`, not `Popen`/`os.posix_spawn`/`asyncio.create_subprocess_exec`); that precondition is enforced per-site by that gate's `test_legitimized_site_mechanism_pins_hold`. `op_total_pending_drain_superseded`=39, measured 2026-08-19: the pending_drain_superseded shape's own 23 `git_native._git` calls PLUS 16 more `subprocess.run` calls the seam cannot see -- the fixture's own scratch-clone/direct-URL setup calls are excluded (the counter is scoped to the `_handler` invocation only, `_count_op_spawns_both_ways`'s own docstring), so the +16 is entirely inside the invocation: `auto_push.drain_pending_push`'s read of the pending record, `_branch_resolves_locally`, `run_push_with_retry`'s own `rev-parse` reads (local_sha, old_remote_sha for the cockpit-touched check), `push_once`'s own rejected push (site 1), `_is_superseded`'s fetch plus `_is_ancestor`'s `merge-base --is-ancestor` (site 2), and `_invoke_cockpit_publish`'s own child process (site 3, the DoE publish script) -- this is exactly the three previously-`_UNCOUNTED_MEASURED_UNREACHED`-then-`_LEGITIMIZED_SITES` sites this fixture exists to discharge, none of it routed through `git_native._git` by construction (`auto_push` is a hook with callers outside this pipeline; rerouting it was rejected for the same reason the other three op_total deltas were).

changelog.cited_in_range_count._rationale: 2026-08-15 fleet spawn census re-verification (state/audits/2026-08-15-fleet-census-reverification-at-head.md § 'Rows surviving intact and unguarded'): `_cited_in_range_count` spawned one `git rev-parse --verify` per unique hex-looking token found via regex over a free-text changelog body -- unbounded by construction, no memo, no timeout. Fix: `_batch_resolve_commits` resolves the whole token set in ONE `git cat-file --batch-check` process (stdin-fed, `timeout=_SUBPROCESS_TIMEOUT`), each token queried as `{tok}^{commit}` to match the prior per-token `rev-parse --verify -q {tok}^{commit}` peel byte-for-byte -- the set of tokens classified as resolving to a commit is unchanged, only the spawn shape is. `target_ms`/`tolerance` satisfy `budget.py._validated_budget`'s required override shape only; `spawn_count_budget` is the enforced invariant, guarded by `coordinator_core/ops/test_changelog_cited_in_range_spawn_bound.py`. `n_tokens=1`: any nonzero number of distinct tokens costs exactly one subprocess (was N before the fix). `no_tokens=0`: an empty token set short-circuits before spawning at all.

percolate.functional_identifier_output_d._rationale: 2026-08-15 audit (state/audits/2026-08-15-fleet-census-reverification-at-head.md row 7): `find_functional_identifier_output_drift_in_tree` (coordinator_core/percolate/store.py) ran `_git_commit_epoch_time` -- one `git log -1 --format=%ct` spawn -- per candidate file whenever a caller supplied `dest_publish_time`, unbounded by construction. This op's sole non-test caller, `publish.py`'s `dispatch_end_of_run_functional_identifier_output_drift_check`, never supplies `dest_publish_time` (its own docstring: 'that branch forks one git log per file ... and is what killed two prior measurement attempts on this machine's shared, heavily-loaded tree'), so the branch is currently reachable only from tests -- `no_dest_publish_time=0` documents the production caller's actual (unchanged, already-zero) spawn count. Fix: `_git_commit_epoch_times_batch` resolves the whole candidate-file set in ONE `git log --format=%x00%ct --name-only -- <paths...>` spawn (newest-commit-first, first occurrence per path wins, matching `git log -1 --format=%ct -- path` semantics exactly) instead of one spawn per file, for any FUTURE caller that does supply `dest_publish_time` -- the set of drift triples returned is unchanged, only the spawn shape is. `target_ms`/`tolerance` satisfy `budget.py._validated_budget`'s required override shape only; `spawn_count_budget` is the enforced invariant, guarded by `coordinator_core/percolate/tests/test_functional_identifier_output_drift_spawn_budget.py`. `with_dest_publish_time_n_files=1`: any nonzero number of candidate files costs exactly one subprocess (was N before the fix) once `dest_publish_time` is supplied.

bin.coordinator_harvest_deferrals_dedup_._rationale: 2026-08-15 audit (state/audits/2026-08-15-fleet-composed-op-spawn-census.md row 13 / state/audits/2026-08-15-fleet-census-reverification-at-head.md): `coordinator-harvest-deferrals.py::_harvest`'s per-row loop calls `_candidate_search_dirs(row)` for every candidate, which in turn calls `_repo_root()` (a `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` subprocess spawn), `_resolved_doe_root()`, and `_resolved_claude_klabauter_root()` (each capable of its own machine-local-registry/marketplace-cache subprocess spawn) FRESH per row -- 3 resolution calls x N rows for an answer invariant for the whole process's lifetime. The per-row WRITE dispatch itself (`_run_queue_append`/`_run_lesson_promote`, already timeout-bounded at `_SUBPROCESS_TIMEOUT_SECS`, and since the 2026-08-15 staff review also catches `subprocess.TimeoutExpired` and degrades it to a per-row failure) is deliberately left one-spawn-per-row -- each row's write stays isolated via the `_run_*` helpers' return-False contract, not a `try` inside `_harvest()` itself, so one row's failure or hang never blocks another's. Fix (root resolution): memoize the three resolution calls (`_repo_root_cache`/`_resolved_doe_root_cache`/`_resolved_claude_klabauter_root_cache`, first-call-wins, mirroring the pre-existing `_CLI_CMD_CACHE` pattern). Fix (directory scan, 2026-08-15 staff review Defect 2 -- the expensive half of the per-row work an earlier pass left unhoisted): `_already_harvested` re-globbed AND re-read EVERY `*.yaml` file in up to four directories (`state/improvement-queue`, `state/lessons-outbox`, in both claude-klabauter and DoE) ONCE PER CANDIDATE ROW -- `_derive_proposed_action`'s own docstring measures those corpora at 605/493 entries, i.e. O(rows x ~1100 full file reads) for a key set invariant across the loop. `_collect_evidence_lines(search_dirs)` now does that glob+read ONCE, before the loop, returning the flat list of `evidence:`-prefixed lines; `_already_harvested(key, evidence_lines)` is then an O(1)-per-row substring membership check against that pre-collected list, preserving the exact prior match semantics (line must start with `evidence:`, key checked via substring). `target_ms`/`tolerance` are carried only to satisfy `budget.py._validated_budget`'s required override shape -- this key is not a real op, `spawn_count_budget` is the enforced invariant. Enforced by `coordinator/bin/tests/test_harvest_deferrals_dedup_scan_memoized.py` (`resolution_calls_for_5_candidate_rows=2` -- exactly one SPAWN each from `_resolved_doe_root()`/`_resolved_claude_klabauter_root()` regardless of candidate-row count, fixture: 5 rows, versus 15 pre-fix; lowered from 3 to 2 on 2026-08-17 because eacbba04a routed `_repo_root()` through `coordinator_core.git.repo_root.show_toplevel`, which walks for the ordinary case and spawns only when the walk finds no `.git` entry -- the budget counts spawns, so that third call is no longer one. Memoization of all three is unchanged and still asserted; do NOT raise this back to 3 to make a regression pass) and `coordinator/bin/tests/test_harvest_deferrals_evidence_scan_hoisted.py` (`directory_scan_calls_for_5_candidate_rows=1` -- `_collect_evidence_lines`/the underlying `glob.glob`+file-read pass runs exactly once per `_harvest()` invocation regardless of candidate-row count, versus once per row pre-fix; asserts the CALL COUNT of the scan, not wall-clock).

bin.workday_complete_close_backfill_disp._rationale: 2026-08-15 audit (state/audits/2026-08-15-fleet-composed-op-spawn-census.md row 14): `workday-complete-close.py::cmd_backfill_dispatch_rows` dispatches ONE full composed step9-ceremony subprocess (`_dispatch_step9_row`) per gap date, up to the 14-day lookback -- deliberately left one-spawn-per-gap-date: each row's exit code is tracked independently and the loop's own contract ('one bad day should not abandon the rest of the backfill') requires row N's failure to never block row N+1's dispatch, so batching into a single invocation is NOT equivalent and was rejected. `_dispatch_step9_row`'s previously-unbounded `subprocess.run` now carries `timeout=_STEP9_ROW_DISPATCH_TIMEOUT_SECS` (120s), with a `TimeoutExpired` caught and converted to a per-row failure (rc=1) rather than crashing the whole loop, preserving per-row isolation under a timeout the same as under a subprocess failure. `target_ms`/`tolerance` are carried only to satisfy `budget.py._validated_budget`'s required override shape -- this key is not a real op. 2026-08-15 staff review: a prior `spawn_count_budget.spawns_per_gap_date=1` was removed here -- it was N==N (true by definition for any one-spawn-per-row implementation, bounds nothing) and its docstring wording actively forbade the correct duplicate-date dedup fix (workday-complete-close.py::cmd_backfill_dispatch_rows now skips a re-seen date rather than re-dispatching it), which would have made a 3-row input with one duplicate cost 2 spawns and broken that tautological assertion. The real invariants (timeout present on every row dispatch; a duplicated date dispatches once, not twice; one row's timeout does not abort the rest) are behavioural, not spawn-count-shaped, and are enforced directly by `coordinator/bin/tests/test_workday_complete_backfill_dispatch_timeout.py` without a manifest budget.

bin.reap_integrated_review_findings.trac._rationale: 2026-08-15 lower-confidence sweep candidate (state/audits/2026-08-15-fleet-census-reverification-at-head.md 'Lower confidence, fan-out unit unconfirmed'): reap-integrated-review-findings.py::_reap_integrated_legacy spawned one 'git ls-files --error-unmatch -- <path>' per marker-bearing findings sidecar in `to_reap` to split it into tracked/untracked buckets before git rm/commit. Fix: ONE 'git ls-files -z -- <all rel paths>' call; git's own output (forward-slash, tracked-only) set-membership-checked against each candidate's relpath (normalized off os.sep for Windows) replaces the per-path --error-unmatch probe. target_ms/tolerance are carried only to satisfy budget.py._validated_budget's required override shape -- this key is not a real op, spawn_count_budget is the enforced invariant. bin.workday_complete_step2_5_dirty_tree.._rationale: 2026-08-15 lower-confidence sweep candidate (state/audits/2026-08-15-fleet-census-reverification-at-head.md 'Lower confidence, fan-out unit unconfirmed'): workday_complete_step2_5_dirty_tree.py::_classify_main_pass spawned one 'git diff --quiet -- <path>' (EOL-PHANTOM probe) and one 'git ls-files --stage -- <path>' (SUBMODULE probe) per dirty status line, up to 2N spawns for N dirty paths. Enforced by coordinator_core/ops/test_workday_complete_step2_5_dirty_tree_spawn_budget.py: per_classify_call=2 -- exactly the two batched git subprocesses regardless of dirty-path count (fixture: several paths across EOL/submodule/other branches).

execute_plan_assemble.dispatch_ledger_de._rationale: 2026-08-15 fleet-composed-op-spawn census row 18 (state/audits/2026-08-15-fleet-composed-op-spawn-census.md, reverified in state/audits/2026-08-15-fleet-census-reverification-at-head.md 'Rows surviving intact and unguarded'): close_out_and_stamp.py::_dispatch_ledger_delivered spawned one 'git cat-file -e <sha>' plus one 'git merge-base --is-ancestor <sha> HEAD' per Dispatch Ledger row citing a committed sha -- a 20-chunk plan was 40 spawns. This is the legacy pre-spine Dispatch Ledger fallback (reached only when a plan has no '## Tasks' spine); a plan with a task-spine never reaches it. Fix: _batch_git_cat_file_check (one 'git cat-file --batch-check', stdin-fed with every distinct cited sha) and _rev_list_ancestor_shas (one 'git rev-list HEAD', membership test replaces per-sha 'merge-base --is-ancestor') -- TWO spawns total for the whole table, regardless of row count, versus 2N before. The returned (is_shipped, missing_chunk_ids, error) verdict is unchanged -- only the spawn shape is. Also added: this module's shared _run_git now carries _GIT_TIMEOUT_SECS=20.0 (previously unbounded). target_ms/tolerance satisfy budget.py._validated_budget's required override shape only; this key is not a real op, spawn_count_budget is the enforced invariant. Enforced by coordinator_core/execute_plan_assemble/tests/test_dispatch_ledger_delivered_spawn_budget.py: no_committed_rows=0 (a table with zero 'committed <sha>'-shaped rows never spawns git at all); n_committed_rows=2 -- exactly the two batched subprocesses for a multi-row fixture citing several distinct shas.

execute_plan_assemble.sibling_committed_._rationale: 2026-08-15 fleet-composed-op-spawn census row 10 (state/audits/2026-08-15-fleet-composed-op-spawn-census.md, reverified in state/audits/2026-08-15-fleet-census-reverification-at-head.md 'Rows surviving intact and unguarded'): close_out_and_stamp.py's own main routine called _sibling_committed_chunk_ids TWICE per closeout with byte-identical inputs -- once inside _determine_shipped for the real cross-repo evidence union, once again purely to surface skipped_sibling_repos for the result dict (the second call's own committed-ids return was discarded) -- doubling the per-sibling git fan-out (4-6 git spawns per sibling repo, unbounded by sibling count) for zero evidence gain. Latent-bug fix: the second call site had also silently omitted its own repo_root argument (defaulting to None), which both weakened _plan_sibling_repo_ids' containment check there AND meant the two calls' inputs never actually matched; passing repo_root there now (identical to the first call's own) is what makes the two calls' inputs identical. Fix: _SIBLING_COMMITTED_MEMO, a process-lifetime module dict keyed on the full (plan_text, deliverable_id, spine_ids, repo_root) input tuple, returns fresh set()/list() copies on a cache hit instead of re-scanning every sibling repo. The real per-sibling git cost when scope: names siblings not yet scanned this process is unchanged -- this fix removes the DUPLICATE scan, not the underlying per-sibling cost. target_ms/tolerance satisfy budget.py._validated_budget's required override shape only; this key is not a real op, spawn_count_budget is the enforced invariant. Enforced by coordinator_core/execute_plan_assemble/tests/test_sibling_committed_chunk_ids_memo_spawn_budget.py: second_call_identical_inputs=0 -- a second call with the exact same arguments as a prior call spawns zero additional git subprocesses. first_call_one_sibling=3 (added 2026-08-19, opro-03 C6): the op's FIRST-call shape, which the memo-hit shape cannot express. second_call_identical_inputs=0 was this op's only budgeted shape, and a shape that spawns nothing by construction can never make any spawn site visible to a counter -- which is why coordinator_core/tests/test_no_uncounted_spawn_on_budgeted_path.py held close_out_and_stamp.py::_run_git permanently red under this op, for want of a shape rather than a fixture precondition. The 3 is one _chunk_evidence_log_range merge-base resolution plus two _deliverable_log_records queries, all issued against a real sibling repo. _resolve_sibling_repo_root is stubbed in that test to a real temp repo: the stub replaces MACHINE-REGISTRY RESOLUTION, not the measured work (the suite's autouse home quarantine nulls registry_get, so an unstubbed sibling id is skipped before any git call), and every counted spawn is one the per-sibling fan-out genuinely issued.

ops.discover_working_repos._spawn_count_rationale: Two LAYERS of key, deliberately. The op_total_* keys are the OP: main() end-to-end, nothing stubbed, measured 2026-08-19 (opro-03 C6) at 3 / 3 / 0 for the Tier-A-non-empty, Tier-B-fallback and all-tiers-empty shapes. Three because _sort_unique shells to sort -u once per NON-EMPTY call and main() reaches it three times -- _tier_a's tail, _tier_a5's tail, and main's own merge tail; the all-empty shape is 0 because _sort_unique early-returns on an empty list without spawning. That shell-out is a SANCTIONED carve-out (test_no_bash_dependency.py names it, for byte-parity with the bash oracle), so it is counted, not removed; reducing it is a carve-out decision, not a budget one. The other two keys are SUB-PATHS and must not be read as the op total: per_call=1 is _tier_a5 alone, and machine_local_cli_elimination_calls=0 isolates _merged_flat_registry's elimination of the per-key machine-local CLI spawns, legitimately stubbing _sort_unique to do so. History worth keeping: per_call was 0 until 2026-08-19 because the asserting test monkeypatched out _sort_unique -- the one function on that path that spawns -- immediately before counting, so the figure was true of a stubbed op and false of this one. The op total went unmeasured for longer still because _tier_a reads Path.home()/.claude/projects and the pre-existing COORDINATOR_TIER_A_FS_ROOT seam covers only the existence probe; COORDINATOR_TIER_A_PROJECTS_DIR was added to make a hermetic main() count possible at all. No spawn was ever added by any of this -- each raise made an existing spawn countable. Trace: state/audits/2026-08-19-opro-03-c08-budgeted-op-spawn-trace.md.
ops.discover_working_repos._rationale: 2026-08-15 staff review of the fleet spawn sweep (state/audits/2026-08-15-fleet-census-reverification-at-head.md). discover_working_repos.py::_tier_a5 spawned one machine-local keys subprocess plus one machine-local get <key> per repos.* key, and ::_publish_mirror_keys independently repeated the whole pattern for publish.mirrors.*.path -- measured live at ~24 interpreter spawns per main() call (19 repos keys + 4 mirror paths), each with a 10s timeout, on a box CLAUDE.md sizes at 50-70 concurrent LLM sessions. This was not merely slow: it contradicted the standing negative spec in coordinator_core/machine_resolver.py, which forbids shelling out to that CLI, and the 2026-08-05 PM directive on de-bashing spawn amplification that it records. It was also LESS CORRECT than a direct read -- registry_get's docstring notes the CLI lives under a resettable bin directory, so the CLI working is not proof of reset-survival, while a direct file read is. Fix: _merged_flat_registry merges registry.local.toml over registry.toml via machine_resolver.load_flat_registry_file/registry_dir (direct tomllib), zero subprocesses. Concern-layer parity was verified rather than assumed: _machine_local.py::_flatten_nested documents these keys as root-namespace-only and actively drops concern-name collisions, so a flat two-file read cannot miss a repo. target_ms/tolerance satisfy budget.py._validated_budget's required override shape only; spawn_count_budget is the enforced invariant, guarded by coordinator_core/ops/test_discover_working_repos_spawn_budget.py. per_call=0 is a real ceiling, not a per-item ratio -- any key count costs zero subprocesses, so a regression to the CLI fails at 1.
